answer: The bridge holds work receipts rather than names, so the vine of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. By the haven of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, diluted when peers disagree, each submission carries a fresh nonce.
